originalTitle: Car owners want tech they can ignore

content: Automakers keep shoving more tech into their cars, despite evidence that consumers are increasingly fed up with huge screens and glitchy software. In fact, the features that car owners appreciate the most happen to be the ones they barely notice, according to the latest tech survey from JD Power. The consumer research firm surveyed 68,084 owners of new 2026 model-year vehicles after 90 days of ownership. The survey touched on 40 automotive technologies covering comfort and convenience; connected vehicles; driver assist; electric vehicles; and smart vehicles. The features that scored the highest were the ones that were the most inconspicuous, like smart ignition, in which the vehicle automatically starts and turns off based on driver actions, or smart HVAC systems, which use AI to automatically adjust the cabin environment for maximum comfort and efficiency. These were the big winners in JD’s survey — mostly because they require the least attention from the driver. Smart ignition, in particular, delivered the highest overall satisfaction, with only 2.4 problems per 100 vehicles. “For automakers, the opportunity is to prioritize technology that makes driving simpler, not more complicated,” Doron Hikry, director of customer success at JD Power, said in a press release. “The features that solve real problems without adding effort or stress for the driver are the ones resonating most with customers.” Superfluous tech features like passenger screens, in which an extra screen is embedded in the dash in front of passengers, rated the lowest in satisfaction. These screens first began cropping up in premium brands, like Mercedes, BMW, and Porsche, but have yet to bleed over to more mass-market vehicles. Apparently, they’re just wasted space on the dash, with more than one-third of owners who have a passenger screen reporting they’ve never tried to use it. Only 6 percent admitted to using their passenger screens every time they drive. Yikes. Another tech feature that has more work to do in winning over customers is hands-free driving, also known as Level 2 Plus automation. These are features like Tesla’s Full Self-Driving, Ford’s BlueCruise, GM’s Super Cruise, and Mercedes’ Drive Pilot. Unlike Level 2 systems, which require drivers to keep their hands on the steering wheel, these L2 Plus systems allow for completely hands-free driving on certain roads. Car owners told JD Power they preferred L2 systems in terms of design and quality of experience, suggesting that more automation does not necessarily mean more customer satisfaction. Interestingly, Level 2 systems were recording slightly higher problems per 100 vehicles (14.3) as L2 Plus ones (13.8). “The results indicate that owners may currently be more comfortable with systems that clearly assist the driver rather than those that introduce a greater degree of automation,” said Hikry. What these results suggest is that car owners don’t necessarily mind more technology in their vehicles, just as long as they don’t make the task of driving more complicated. The individual awards underscore this point: The Cadillac Escalade and Toyota Tundra both won for camera mirrors, while other automakers notched wins for blind-spot cameras, digital keys, one-pedal driving, and EV charging schedulers.
chineseTitle: 车主想要他们可以忽视的技术
chineseSummary: 尽管有证据表明消费者越来越厌倦巨大的屏幕和有问题的软件，但汽车制造商仍在不断将更多技术融入他们的汽车中。事实上，根据 JD Power 的最新技术调查，车主最欣赏的功能恰恰是他们几乎没有注意到的功能。这家消费者研究公司调查了 68,084 人 […]
chineseContent: 尽管有证据表明消费者越来越厌倦巨大的屏幕和有问题的软件，但汽车制造商仍在不断将更多技术融入他们的汽车中。事实上，根据 JD Power 的最新技术调查，车主最欣赏的功能恰恰是他们几乎没有注意到的功能。这家消费者研究公司在拥有 90 天后对 68,084 名 2026 年款新车车主进行了调查。该调查涉及40项汽车技术，涵盖舒适性和便利性；联网车辆；驾驶员辅助；电动汽车；和智能汽车。得分最高的功能都是最不起眼的功能，比如智能点火，车辆根据驾驶员的动作自动启动和关闭，或者智能暖通空调系统，利用人工智能自动调整车内环境，以实现最大的舒适度和效率。这些是京东调查中的大赢家——主要是因为它们需要司机的关注最少。尤其是智能点火，总体满意度最高，每 100 辆车仅出现 2.4 个问题。 JD Power 客户成功总监 Doron Hikry 在一份新闻稿中表示：“对于汽车制造商来说，机会是优先考虑使驾驶变得更简单而不是更复杂的技术。” “能够在不增加驾驶员精力或压力的情况下解决实际问题的功能最能引起客户的共鸣。”乘客屏幕等多余的技术功能满意度最低，其中乘客屏幕上嵌入了一个额外的屏幕。这些屏幕首先出现在梅赛德斯、宝马和保时捷等高端品牌中，但尚未渗透到更多大众市场车辆中。显然，它们只是浪费了仪表板上的空间，超过三分之一的空间
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
